fusions.name: Full Draw
fusions.desc: Draws the spade back to the shoulder and drives it out to full extension for 26 damage, rising to 2 times that at its full reach of 4 tiles. The blow ignores armour.

fusions.name: Sprung Haft
fusions.desc: Bends the haft back against the ground and lets it snap, flinging its load as 3 shots spread apart, each dealing 5 damage. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Archer's Stakes
fusions.desc: Digs in a row of sharpened stakes 5 tiles long for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Range Found
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 12. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: a blow strikes it for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (326% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
